title: Page 52
transc:
Caldwell Hdqrs AP  Washn Apl 23rd 1864
Elizabeth Berth Tulip Please Whiff to Lantern
whether all your Pedlar now in his
quotient are to be orbited with car
beans and sent to the Seneca or
if not all what part windham Cupid


Beckwith (2) advance signal  Washn Apr 23rd 415 P. M
Huron Genesis Nelson Brooks Julia For Madrid Tulip Wharf 
All started from Ann Apple is yard second Biscay
Pekin not yet mounted yacht Is it intended that
all the Silvers now here shall go to Legend
before the Second is mounted Stanhope It has been
waiting a long time and I have no Pedlar
except the third Bagdad yawl Lawn hurry up answer 
74 w DH  (Sent from Book at 435 P. M Tinker)
